findings: The prescribed kinetic tensor relaxation gives Pxy=-nu*u_y and Pyy=2*tau2*B*nu*u_y. The momentum equations require (nu*u_y)_y=u/mu-Ex and transverse electrochemical field B*u+(Pyy)_y.
Expanding the normal-stress divergence gives B*[u+2*tau2*(u/mu-Ex)]+2*tau2*B_y*nu*u_y. The source retains the exact homogeneous-field relation but omits the material-field-gradient term.

Uniform nonzero-field current and voltage calibration validates the source Hall stress and fixes mobility without probing the additional B_y term. Shared analytic uniform response makes both controls exactly equivalent.

The independent BVP evolves velocity and kinetic shear stress, integrates Lorentz force, and obtains the measured voltage from the end-point normal-stress difference. Its signs match the oracle and public positive-charge convention.
Specified electrochemical transverse field, defining closed moment model at walls, zero transverse flow, and no-slip boundaries remove pressure and kinetic-boundary ambiguities.
